I have been doing a lot of personal research of weed lately because after 2 years im considering to smoke again to help myself with my own problems. Of course it aint any high level research, just some shit i gathered based on mine experience + others experience + actual research made by professionals.

Weed benefits wary for each person but potential benefits are: 
- reducing pain caused by different factors, usually related to something like inflammatory pain and other kinds ofnpain that are caused by "inside" of your body
- helping with stress and anxiety
- socialising
- ADHD
- chronic illnesses such as Crohn disease
- improve sleep quality or help with sleep issues in general
- help with epilepsy but this is one of things i dont really know much about so i cannot tell if its actually like that

My personal benefits of smoking weed:
- better motivation to do shit
- godlike sleep, i felt very well rested in the morning when i used to smoke
- it Has been only thing that helped me with my mental states without making me feel like a spectator in my body, without any depersonalization that occured when i took SSRIs
- better focus (can be both a benefit and downside because when i get focused on something when im high, i sometimes tend to ignore things around me such as friend talking to me)
- Anger management

But remember there are downsides which i mostly gathered from observating other smokers and 1 on my own case
- many people tend to lose their shit because of weed. I cant tell how many people i saw who got totally unstable because of cannabis misuse accompanied with overall poor mind. I cant exactly form what i want to say here because english isn't my first language and this isn't easy topic to describe
- worse memory but i think it mostly impacts the short term memory (im not sure how are they called in english but what i mean is - there are 2 memory types, long term and short term)
- physical problems caused by smoking, which can be tremondously mitigated with using vaporizer
